init.title: Configure Assist agent
init.description: Choose the model and Home Assistant tool access for this Assist agent. The model is validated with a streaming test request.

data_description.prompt: Instruct how the LLM should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Select which tools the model can use to interact with your devices and entities.
data_description.mcp_server_ids: Optional MCP servers this Assist agent may use. Runtime use requires the MCP server to have an explicit allowed-tools list.
data_description.temperature: Controls response randomness. Leave empty to use the provider or model default.
data_description.thinking: Optional reasoning effort or boolean thinking control. Provider and model support varies.
data_description.configure_advanced_model_settings: Open a second step for token limits, sampling, timeout, tool-call behavior, seed, penalties, and JSON overrides.

model_settings.title: Advanced model settings
model_settings.description: Set optional Pydantic AI ModelSettings values for this Assist agent. Leave fields empty to use provider defaults.

data_description.max_tokens: Maximum tokens the model may generate. Must be a positive integer.
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling value. Leave empty to use the provider default.
data_description.timeout: Request timeout in seconds. Must be positive. If empty, validation uses the integration default timeout.
data_description.parallel_tool_calls: Allow the model/provider to make tool calls in parallel when supported.
data_description.seed: Optional non-negative integer seed for providers that support deterministic sampling.
data_description.presence_penalty: Penalty for introducing tokens already present in the conversation. Provider support and ranges vary.
data_description.frequency_penalty: Penalty based on token frequency in the conversation. Provider support and ranges vary.
data_description.extra_headers: JSON object of string headers to send with model requests. These values are stored in Home Assistant config entry storage; do not use this for API secrets.
data_description.extra_body: JSON object merged into provider request bodies for provider-specific options.

init.title: Configure MCP server
init.description: Add a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server. Stdio/local command servers are not supported by this integration.

data_description.mcp_url: HTTP or HTTPS URL for the remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Local, LAN, mDNS, and public hosts are supported. HTTPS is recommended when using headers or sensitive tool data.
data_description.mcp_headers: Optional JSON object of string HTTP headers. Values are redacted in diagnostics.
data_description.mcp_allowed_tools: Optional comma-separated allowlist. Leave empty to discover all tools, then narrow this list before enabling runtime use.

error.invalid_mcp_headers: Enter a JSON object with string header names and string values.
